exposure: extra-uterine growth restriction (EUGR) defined by weight z-score < 10 percentile at TEA, 6 and 12 months, or z-score decreased by 1-point standard deviation from birth to TEA and from TEA to 6 months
outcome: Griffiths Mental Development Scale II (GMDS II) global developmental quotient (DQ) at 2 and 3 years
cohort: The study included 288 very-low-birth-weight (VLBW) neonates with no or low-grade MRI lesions, scanned at a term equivalent age (TEA), born between 2012 and 2018.
finding: A worse weight z-score at 6 months of age is an independent risk factor for significantly reduced GMDS across multiple developmental areas at 2 and 3 years.
